events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey check files, key names, ledger and git state
events.input: $ wc -l cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md cloud/scripts/probe-connector-guards.mjs scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md && cat cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md | cut -c1-600 && echo ---KEYS && (sed -E 's/=.*/=<set>/' ~/.config/tantra/keys/vendor-test.env 2>&1 | head -30) && echo ---LEDGER && tail -8 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-500 && git status --short cloud/scripts cloud/src/connectors scripts/walkthroughs | head && git log --oneline -6 -- cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs cloud/src/connectors && git status -sb | head -1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Outline the check script and its key names
events.input: $ grep -n "process.env\.\|_TEST_\|GHL_API_KEY\|INSTANTLY\|^const CHECKS\|^async function \|^function \|case '\|case \"" cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-220 | head -120

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the rest of the survey output

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the script's key loader, ledger writer and main
events.input: $ sed -n 20,64p cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-260; sed -n 443,460p cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: Key names, ledger tail, CHECKS rows, git state
events.input: $ echo ---KEYS; sed -E 's/=.*/=<set>/' ~/.config/tantra/keys/vendor-test.env 2>&1 | head -20; echo ---OTHERKEYS; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys/ ~/.config/tantra/ 2>&1 | head -30; echo ---LEDGER; tail -6 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-380; echo ---CHECKS rows; awk -F'|' 'NR>10{print NR": "$2"|"substr($3,1,90)"|"substr($4,1,110)}' cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md; echo ---GIT; git status --short cloud/scripts cloud/src/connectors scripts/walkthroughs | head; git status -sb | head -1; git log --oneline -4 -- cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs cloud/src/connectors

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run check listing, guard probe and type check
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs 2>&1 | cut -c1-200; echo ---PROBE; node cloud/scripts/probe-connector-guards.mjs 2>&1 | tail -22 | cut -c1-200; echo ---TSC; (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; echo tsc-exit=$?)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check template-variable row, WhatsApp references and unverified markers
events.input: $ echo ---tmplvar; grep -rn -i "unused\|template variable\|stripVars\|twTemplate" cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md cloud/src/connectors/twilio.ts cloud/scripts/probe-connector-guards.mjs cloud/src/jobs-twilio.ts | cut -c1-260 | head -12; echo ---whatsapp; grep -n -i "whatsapp" cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs cloud/scripts/probe-connector-guards.mjs cloud/src/connectors/twilio.ts | cut -c1-200 | head; sed -n 19p cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md | cut -c1-900; echo ---UNVERIFIED; grep -rn "UNVERIFIED" cloud/src/connectors cloud/src/jobs-*.ts | cut -c1-240 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Trace the Twilio template-variable check through history
events.input: $ git log --oneline -S"template variable" -- cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md cloud/src/connectors/twilio.ts cloud/scripts/probe-connector-guards.mjs | head; git log --oneline -S"twUnusedVars" -- cloud | head -4; git show ad3ebaf:cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md | grep -n -i "variable" | cut -c1-500; echo ---; git show ad3ebaf:cloud/src/connectors/twilio.ts | grep -n -i "variable\|ContentVariables" | cut -c1-260 | head; echo --- now; grep -rn -i "ContentVariables\|Content/v1\|content.twilio" cloud/src | cut -c1-200 | head
